description: Compile flags beyond -I/-D: -include config.h (supplies feature macros), -iquote src/internal and -isystem vendor/include are required to preprocess correctly
notes: config.h (project root) is only reachable via -include; without it src/tlv.c hits #error and src/version.c fails on TLV_VERSION_STRING. ENABLE_NESTED=1 makes walk_nested (and the walk_level<->walk_nested recursion) compiled; ENABLE_STRICT=0 excludes tag_known. tlvdefs.h is found only via -iquote src/internal; endian_compat.h only via -isystem vendor/include (it defines a macro, no functions).

trust.rule: step I7, no threat model: library API and an executable's embedded API untrusted (default, boundary); functions reached in the call graph from a function calling an input reader or from main with argv untrusted (call_graph; main with argv is a boundary); every other function trusted (default)
